install_signal_handlers: install signal handlers for SLURM SIGUSR1 and SIGTERM to handle job pre-emption and requeuing
initialize_distributed_mode: initialize distributed PyTorch training mode for single GPU, multi-GPU, or multi-node SLURM jobs
handle_slurm_signal: handle SLURM SIGUSR1 signal by requeuing the job on the master process and exiting
bypass_sigterm: handle SLURM SIGTERM signal by logging and bypassing it without termination
setup_pytorch_distributed: set up distributed training environment variables and PyTorch process group for multi-GPU jobs
